result.reason: The clause adopts New York law and expressly selects the state and federal courts in New York County, but it leaves intact language allowing an arbitrator’s award to be confirmed in any court of competent jurisdiction, including in the opposing party’s federal district. That residual arbitration and non-New York forum language is inconsistent with exclusive New York County court jurisdiction and should be deleted or conformed. The changes otherwise remain confined to governing law and dispute forum and preserve unrelated terms.
